name: wake
description: Return relevant current memory across all projects and whether current-context maintenance is waiting. Without a task, return availability and a reading call rather than the whole library. Larger task results include a search_memory continuation call.

project_name.description: Optional current-task context; it does not restrict the default memory search.

current_task.description: Optional current task used to build a task-aware wake packet.

budget_tokens.description: Size of the complete wake response. Omit to use cost_budget.wake_tokens. All remaining facts remain readable through continuation.

scope.description: All current memory by default; project is an explicit optional filter.
